notes.intake: Rule-based guess: line ID from the image name (table, matches 100% of images against genetic/knockouts_012.csv.gz::rows).
notes.images: Subject size shifts with the source image dimensions (about 1.24x between imaging setups): a magnification change, so each image-size group is scaled to the largest group. Brightness and contrast drift with imaging month and setup, so each image is stretched between its own subject percentiles. The grey-scale legend on 68% of images is painted over. Excluded 12: 7 inverted X-rays and 1 sideways view (subject darker than its background), and 2 pairs of identical pictures filed under different mice. The 374 grey-background images flagged for review are kept; normalisation evens them out.
notes.traits: Eight body and X-ray measurements that outline real structure. None tracks an imported IMPC trait: the high correlations with the caudal vertebra count rest on the few mice that have it, so every trait is scored against the same measurement on the real X-rays. Vertebra and rib counts and tibia length need a skeleton segmenter, which this recipe does not have.
notes.genetics: Each line differs at only a few columns (or there are few markers), so every column is read directly instead of through a PCA.
notes.training: large gives 4395 parameters per image against a target of 4200 for this image variety (42 PCs for 90%); 210 diffusion and 80 LiteVAE epochs match the earlier runs' steps.
notes.qc_finished: Both runs are healthy. The one warning, a LiteVAE loss spike at epoch 15, is the collapse seen on 2026-11-20: the spike guard caught it, training recovered within five epochs, and the LiteVAE the diffusion model uses is from epoch 71. The diffusion run converged with a positive genotype gain on held-out mice, and its previews are whole mice like the real X-rays. Use the best checkpoint, epoch 209.
notes.analysis_finished: Mean r 0.74 over 8 traits on 730 validation lines (genomic prediction 0.77).

qc_issues: LiteVAE epoch 15: training loss jumped to 1.6 (from 0.0016); the spike guard skipped 321 steps (worst batch loss 665) and validation MSE was back on its earlier trend by epoch 20.
Diffusion: learning rate decayed to 1e-7 and validation loss is flat at 0.0564; held-out genotype gain +0.041 (images fit their own genotype better than a wrong one).
